root: ^<size=85%>A strange phenomenon has the village of Dreslawa in a downward spiral.
^Like every night, residents have gone to bed and fallen asleep — only to never wake up again.
^An older female and an adult male have fallen into inexplicable slumber. The local Dr. Hoffmann has not given any official statement on these incidents, except that it might be chemically induced.

^Many towns and villages have struggled after the war, but most have rebuilt successfully. People across the country have found solace in churches and different faiths while starting anew. After a few interviews, I noticed that the people in Dreslawa find explanations from folktales and superstition in this odd situation.

^Instead of suspecting one of their own, they have started to believe the culprit is the creature Sandman. This fairytale has taken a disturbing turn within this village's beliefs: rather than putting their children to sleep, it induces a profound state of unconsciousness.
^How many victims will Sandman put to bed forever?</size>
